title: docs(boe): reconstruct the v3.1.0-v3.5.0 changelog and correct the Jumbo template row
intent: The Body Outline Editor has no changelog. Its only version marker is an HTML comment on line 7 of hostinger/body-outline-editor.html reading 'v3.5.0 - Final Polish (Precision Tier Complete)', and no git tags exist for any editor version, so the release history was recoverable only from commit messages. This adds docs/Body_Outline_Editor_CHANGELOG.md, reconstructed from git history and verified against per-commit diffs and line counts, covering the pre-tier v3.1.0 baseline and the Precision Tier v3.2.0-v3.5.0. It also corrects the Jumbo row in the User Manual, which has been wrong since commit f25bb949 (2026-05-27) realigned the editor to the canonical IBG source. Documentation only.
behavior_change: none - documentation only. No code, schema, route, workflow, data file, test, or runtime behavior is touched. Adds one markdown file under docs/ and edits one existing markdown file under docs/.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) New docs/Body_Outline_Editor_CHANGELOG.md: per-version entries for v3.1.0 (pre-tier baseline), v3.2.0 Precision Controls + Workflow, v3.3.0 Image Tools & Templates, v3.4.0 Measurement & Enhanced Export, and v3.5.0 Final Polish, plus an Unreleased section for the three commits that changed the editor after the v3.5.0 stamp without a version bump (70a0d3ee IBG API configuration, c971d7a4 JSON import, f25bb949 jumbo alignment). Includes a namespace-and-boundary section recording six overlaps with systems that evolved around the editor. (2) docs/Body_Outline_Editor_User_Manual.md Chapter 7: Jumbo template row corrected from 530/432/304/280 to 530/432/305/254, with an inline note explaining the realignment and naming the consistency test that does not cover this file.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No changelog exists for this artifact and no git tags record its versions; the release history was otherwise only recoverable by reading commit messages one at a time. The root CHANGELOG.md tracks the platform on an independent toolbox-vX.Y.Z line and does not cover the editor's v3.x line - the new file states that distinction explicitly so the two are not conflated. The Jumbo correction fixes a real 26mm waist discrepancy between the manual and shipped behavior.

files.intent: New reconstructed changelog for the Body Outline Editor covering v3.1.0 through v3.5.0, an Unreleased section for the post-stamp commits, namespace/boundary notes, and open items.
Chapter 7: correct the Jumbo template row to the canonical 530/432/305/254 and add an inline note on the realignment and the gap in test coverage.
files.behavior_change: None (documentation). Corrects a stated dimension to match shipped behavior.

findings: The v3.5.0 version stamp is duplicated: it appears on line 7 of BOTH hostinger/body-outline-editor.html (6150 lines) and tools/body-outline-editor.html (5979 lines), which are different builds whose Jumbo waist differs by 26mm. The mirror is a clean snapshot of hostinger@70a0d3ee (0-line diff after CRLF normalisation), 171 lines behind, missing c971d7a4 and f25bb949. MORPHOLOGY_HARVEST_GOVERNANCE_AUDIT.md marks it Production / MEDIUM / 'Avoid collision', so resync is a governed change. Recorded as an open item; not performed in this patch.
test_jumbo_dimension_consistency.py guards four paths and does not cover the User Manual or the tools/ mirror, which is how this drift went unnoticed. Extending it is recorded as an open item.

'Final Polish' also occurs as an unrelated lutherie finishing WBS task in work_breakdown.py:158. Coincidental string match across domains; nothing to reconcile. Recorded so future searches for the release name are not misread.
